review_rounds.detail: F1(P1)+F2/F3/F4/F5(P2); reviewer ran own counterexamples and independent hand-calc
F1-F4 closed by replayed counterexamples; zero new findings; 4 NOT_VERIFIED deferred
reviewer personally ran: du9 47 passed (1.21s); neighbors 618 passed 17 skipped (all env-gated); ruff clean; 20k-window plan per-admit 142.4/157.5ms (linear); zero repo residue

findings.cause: admission path only compared the stored digest string and never re-derived plan content; a plan edited after state mint could carry the old state past the hard balance (reviewer measured max_pages=2 exceeded to 3)
findings.verification_receipt: reviewer replayed 3 attack paths: stale digest -> ValueError('plan_digest does not match plan content'); resigned digest -> same content re-derivation error; legitimately different plan -> ValueError('state belongs to a different plan'); untouched plan unaffected; regression test_f1_tampered_plan_after_state_creation_is_refused

findings.cause: decision envelope echoed unbounded caller objects (1MB page -> 1MB envelope; str keys uncapped; huge key lists materialized before slicing)
findings.verification_receipt: reviewer measured: 1MB page -> '<str>' 357B; 1MB key -> 4096 truncation; 1M-element list -> 64-entry islice echo 680B; page=10**18 -> '<int:19digits>'; valid int pages echoed verbatim; regression test_f2_decision_envelope_is_bounded_against_huge_caller_objects

findings.cause: rule intent fields missing from geometry_intent silently fell back to policy default_intent, contradicting the literal INTERFACES rule 缺字段保守unknown (an aggressive default granted heavy-request capability without diagnostics)
findings.verification_receipt: reviewer confirmed: aggressive default no longer grants capability (requestable {discover: False, fine: False} with POLICY_INTENT_MISSING); complete policy produces zero MISSING noise; fixture quotas unchanged (no behavioral drift); default_intent now planner-inert and declared in docstring + handoff known_limits; regression test_f3_missing_intent_field_stays_unknown_even_with_non_unknown_default

findings.cause: hand-crafted malformed plans raised KeyError instead of ValueError (_require_plan did not validate digest-covered fields or allocation rows)
findings.verification_receipt: reviewer ran 9 malformed cases: all ValueError, zero KeyError; partial plan still mints state and admits with rejected/window_not_in_plan; plan JSON round-trip digest stable; regression test_f4_malformed_plan_raises_valueerror_not_keyerror

findings.cause: task_plan.md B/C statuses and progress.md stale after implementation commits landed
findings.fix_commit: handoff commit (docs-only; code SHA unchanged from db126f24)
findings.verification_receipt: task_plan B/C -> done with commit references; progress.md entry added; handoff.md/json and review/independent_review.md|json land in the same handoff commit; reviewer confirmed the pending write-back appeared in the worktree before commit

residual_boundaries_declared: forging plan+digest+state together equals forging the caller's own in-call state; INTERFACES forbids a sign-off/token system, so this is outside the threat model
per-admit cost is O(plan+state): ~142-158ms/admit on a synthetic 20k-window plan (linear; fixture-scale is sub-millisecond)
policy default_intent is planner-inert under the literal 缺字段保守unknown reading; ROOT/POLICY should confirm its intended consumer
